hypothesis: A residual-focused, entity-disjoint GRPO distribution with hard lexical nuisance combinations will retain useful within-prompt reward variance under the selected V6 SFT checkpoint and can improve fresh-retry routing without regressing nonretryable or exhausted-state controls.

blocking_and_balance.grpo_train: full 4 query styles × 3 badge states × 2 fixture families across 24 entities; every entity is crossed with both detectors and all nine state scenarios
blocking_and_balance.grpo_dev_and_test: full 4 query styles × 3 badge states across 12 entities; fixture families are globally balanced and balanced within each badge margin, with at most one-entity imbalance within a query style; every entity is crossed with both detectors and all nine state scenarios
blocking_and_balance.error_aliases: four disjoint alias families with two spellings each, balanced across detector bundles
blocking_and_balance.run_order: seeded shuffle after the complete blocked layout is generated

design.anti_pseudoreplication_rule: Repeated scenarios and detector variants from one entity are a block, not independent evidence; all reported uncertainty and split isolation are entity-aware.

support_audit.adaptive_scope_rule: Only residual scenarios with at least two nonzero-variance development groups in each detector family and at least 10% combined nonzero-variance rate may enter the optimizer dataset. fresh_retry_step2 must qualify or optimizer steps remain zero.
support_audit.on_fail: Do not run GRPO. Preserve the audit and redesign a new version rather than changing V7 in place.

canary_stop_conditions: any non-finite loss, reward, gradient, parameter, or optimizer state
peak allocated memory above 28 GiB on any rank
fewer than 2 GiB free device memory on any rank
missing reward, policy entropy, gradient norm, or advantage telemetry

test_policy.open_only_after: support gate passes, training scope and hyperparameters are frozen, and the selected checkpoint is locked
test_policy.no_reuse: The opened V6 sealed test is historical design input only and is not a confirmatory V7 endpoint.
